Question Choices: Select. A triangle has angles of 50 degrees, 60 degrees, and 70 degrees. What type of triangle is this based on its angles?: ~~Acute | Right | Obtuse~~
Hints: Check the angle total, then classify using the largest angle and any equal angles.
Solution: The angles total 50 + 60 + 70 =180 degrees. The largest is 70 degrees, below 90, so all angles are acute.

Question Choices: Select. What type of triangle is this based on its sides?: ~~Scalene | Isosceles | Equilateral~~
Hints: Compare all three side lengths: all equal, exactly two equal, or all different.
Solution: The side lengths are 7, 5, 3 cm. All three are different, so the triangle is scalene.

Question Choices: Fill: A triangle has two equal sides, and the angle between those sides is 100 degrees. It is an ___ triangle by its sides and an ___ triangle by its angles.
Hints: Check the angle total, then classify using the largest angle and any equal angles.
Solution: Two equal sides make it isosceles. The included 100-degree angle exceeds 90, making it obtuse. The other equal angles are(180-100)/2=40 degrees.

Question Choices: Fill: A triangle has angles of 56 degrees, 50 degrees and 74 degrees. It is a ___ triangle by its sides and an ___ triangle by its angles.
Hints: Check the angle total, then classify using the largest angle and any equal angles.
Solution: 56+50+74=180 degrees. All three angles differ, so the opposite sides all differ:scalene. Every angle is below 90:acute.

Question Choices: Fill: This triangle is an ________ triangle by its sides and an ________ triangle by its angles.
Hints: Three equal sides give three equal angles sharing 180 degrees.
Solution: All three labeled sides are 4 cm, so it is equilateral. Each marked angle is 60 degrees, less than 90, so it is acute.
